title: Pexels Visuals
description: Preview-first stock visual search. The API key itself stays outside project settings.

media_type.title: Media type
media_type.description: Search videos by default; enable images or both when a scene benefits from stills.

per_query.title: Candidates per query
per_query.description: Number of preview candidates requested for each SceneIntent search query.

orientation.title: Orientation
orientation.description: Auto derives orientation from the SceneIntent aspect ratio.

minimum_size.title: Minimum source size
minimum_size.description: Pexels search filter. Medium maps to Full HD for video.

locale.title: Search locale
locale.description: Pexels locale code used for generated visual search queries.

api_key_env.title: API key environment variable
api_key_env.description: Name of the machine-local environment variable containing the Pexels API key. The secret value is never stored in OmniCreator project data.
